'''Samit Dasgupta''' is a professor of mathematics at [[Duke University]] working in [[algebraic number theory]].

==Biography==
Dasgupta graduated from [[Montgomery Blair High School]] in 1995 and placed fourth in the 1995 [[Westinghouse Science Talent Search]] with a project on [[Schinzel's hypothesis H]].<ref name="MBHS"/> He then attended [[Harvard University]], where he received a bachelor's degree in 1999.<ref name="MBHS">{{cite web |url=https://sites.google.com/a/mbhsmagnet.org/www/news/fall15/dasgupta |title=Samit Dasgupta '95: Algebraic Number Theory |publisher=Montgomery Blair High School Magnet Foundation |date=Fall 2015 |accessdate=August 4, 2020 |archive-date=November 3, 2020 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20201103074602/https://sites.google.com/a/mbhsmagnet.org/www/news/fall15/dasgupta |url-status=dead }}</ref><ref name="Duke-profile">{{cite web |url=https://math.duke.edu/people/samit-dasgupta |title=Samit Dasgupta |publisher=[[Duke University]] Department of Mathematics |accessdate=August 4, 2020}}</ref> In 2004, Dasgupta received a PhD in mathematics from [[University of California, Berkeley]] under the supervision of [[Ken Ribet]] and [[Henri Darmon]].<ref name="mathgenealogy">{{MathGenealogy|id=16985}}</ref>

Dasgupta was previously a faculty member at [[University of California, Santa Cruz]].<ref name="MBHS"/> As of 2020, he is a professor of mathematics at Duke University.<ref name="Duke-profile"/><ref name="homepage">{{cite web |url=https://services.math.duke.edu/~dasgupta |title=Samit Dasgupta |publisher=[[Duke University]] |accessdate=August 4, 2020}}</ref>

==Research==
Dasgupta's research is focused on [[special values of L-functions]], algebraic points on [[abelian variety|abelian varieties]], and [[Unit (ring theory)|unit]]s in [[number field]]s.<ref name="MAA"/> In particular, Dasgupta's research has focused on the [[Stark conjectures]] and [[Heegner point]]s.<ref name="mathgenealogy"/><ref>{{Cite journal |last1=Dasgupta |first1=Samit |last2=Darmon |first2=Henri |last3=Pollack |first3=Robert |year=2011 |title=Hilbert modular forms and the Gross-Stark conjecture |url=http://annals.math.princeton.edu/2011/174-1/p12 |journal=Annals of Mathematics |language=en |volume=174 |issue=1 |pages=439–484 |doi=10.4007/annals.2011.174.1.12 |issn=0003-486X|doi-access=free }}</ref><ref>{{Cite journal |first1=Samit |last1=Dasgupta |first2=Mahesh |last2=Kakde |first3=Kevin |last3=Ventullo |year=2018 |title=On the Gross–Stark Conjecture |journal=Annals of Mathematics |volume=188 |issue=3 |pages=833 |doi=10.4007/annals.2018.188.3.3|jstor=10.4007/annals.2018.188.3.3 |s2cid=53554124 |url=https://kclpure.kcl.ac.uk/portal/en/publications/on-the-grossstark-conjecture(3feab83f-fd60-43e3-811f-ad3be8abd1b4).html }}</ref><ref>{{Cite journal |last1=Dasgupta |first1=Samit |last2=Spieß |first2=Michael |year=2018 |title=Partial zeta values, Gross's tower of fields conjecture, and Gross–Stark units |journal=[[Journal of the European Mathematical Society]] |language=en |volume=20 |issue=11 |pages=2643–2683 |doi=10.4171/JEMS/821 |issn=1435-9855}}</ref>

==Awards==
In 2009, Dasgupta received a [[Sloan Research Fellowship]].<ref name="MAA">{{cite web |url=https://www.maa.org/news/math-news/uc-santa-cruz-mathematician-samit-dasgupta-awarded-sloan-research-fellowship |publisher=[[Mathematical Association of America]] |title=UC Santa Cruz Mathematician Samit Dasgupta Awarded Sloan Research Fellowship |date=February 20, 2009 |accessdate=August 4, 2020 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210609101038/https://www.maa.org/news/math-news/uc-santa-cruz-mathematician-samit-dasgupta-awarded-sloan-research-fellowship|archive-date=2021-06-09|url-status=dead }}</ref> He was named a Fellow of the [[American Mathematical Society]], in the 2022 class of fellows, "for contributions to number theory, in particular the theory of special values of classical and p-adic L-functions".<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.ams.org/cgi-bin/fellows/fellows_by_year.cgi|title=2022 Class of Fellows of the AMS|publisher=American Mathematical Society|access-date=2021-11-05}}</ref>
